entries.api_behavior: NetpbmImage.Resize(newWidth, newHeight) scales image using nearest-neighbor interpolation. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for zero/negative dimensions. Original unchanged; format preserved.

FodsDocument.RemoveSheet(string name) removes named sheet. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent sheet. Sheet count decreases; remaining sheets preserved.
FodtDocument.GetWordFrequency(int minLength=1) returns case-insensitive word-count IReadOnlyDictionary. Splits on whitespace+punctuation. Filters by minLength. Merges across paragraphs.

NetpbmImage.Tile(tilesX, tilesY) returns new image tiling source tilesX*tilesY times. Output dimensions = Width*tilesX by Height*tilesY. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for zero/negative tile counts.

FodsDocument.CopySheet(sourceName, newName) clones sheet with new name. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent source or duplicate new name. Sheet count increases.
FodtDocument.RemoveParagraph(int index) removes paragraph at zero-based index. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative/out-of-range index. Count decreases; subsequent paragraphs shift.
NetpbmImage.Solarize(byte threshold) inverts pixels > threshold (pixel = MaxValue - pixel). PBM images return clone unchanged. Original unmodified.

FodsDocument.SetCellStyle(sheetName, row, col, styleName) assigns named style to cell. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace/nonexistent sheetName. Throws ArgumentNullException for null styleName. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid row/col.
FodtDocument.SetParagraphText(int index, string text) replaces text at zero-based index. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid index. Other paragraphs unchanged; paragraph count unchanged.

NetpbmImage.ApplyGamma(double gamma) applies gamma correction: pixel = MaxValue*(pixel/MaxValue)^gamma. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for zero/negative gamma. PBM returns clone unchanged. Original unmodified.

FodsDocument.SetCellFormula(sheetName, row, col, formula) assigns formula string to cell. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace sheetName. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent sheet. Throws ArgumentNullException for null formula. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid row/col.

FodtDocument.GetPlainTextRange(startIndex, endIndex) returns paragraphs [start,end) concatenated with newlines. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative startIndex or endIndex > ParagraphCount. Returns empty string when start >= end.
NetpbmImage.FlipDiagonal() transposes image (pixel[r,c] -> pixel[c,r]). Output Width=original Height, Height=original Width. Format preserved, original unmodified.

FodsDocument.SortRows(sheetName, sortColumn, ascending=true) sorts rows by column. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace sheetName. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent sheet. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative sortColumn. Single-row is no-op.
FodtDocument.CharCount property returns total character count across all paragraphs (sum of text lengths). Empty doc=0. Empty paragraph contributes 0. Idempotent.
NetpbmImage.Sharpen() applies Laplacian sharpening kernel to PGM/PPM. PBM returns clone unchanged. Border pixels unmodified. Uniform image interior unchanged. Pixels clamped to [0, MaxValue].

FodsDocument.RenameSheet(oldName, newName) renames existing sheet. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace oldName/newName. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent oldName or duplicate newName.
FodtDocument.WordCount property splits GetPlainText() on whitespace (RemoveEmptyEntries). Empty/whitespace-only=0. Idempotent. Increases after AppendParagraph with text.

NetpbmImage.Posterize(int levels) quantizes pixels to nearest of (levels) evenly-spaced buckets. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException if levels < 2. PBM returns clone unchanged. Zero/max pixels unchanged.

FodsDocument.GetColumnHeaders() returns first-row headers from first sheet. GetColumnHeaders(sheetName) returns headers from named sheet. Returns empty for empty/no-sheet/empty-row/nonexistent-named-sheet.

FodtDocument.SetParagraphStyle(int index, string styleName) assigns named style. Throws ArgumentNullException for null styleName. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid index. Paragraph text/count unchanged.
NetpbmImage.MedianFilter(int radius) applies median smoothing. radius=0 returns clone. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative radius. Uniform image interior unchanged. Non-destructive.

FodsDocument.DeleteRows(sheetName, startRow, count) removes count rows starting at startRow. count=0 is no-op. Throws ArgumentException for null/whitespace sheetName. Throws InvalidOperationException for nonexistent sheet. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative count or out-of-bounds range.
FodtDocument.GetTextBetweenParagraphs(startIndex, endIndex) returns null for invalid ranges. Returns paragraphs [start,end) joined by newlines for valid ranges.

NetpbmImage.AdjustContrast(double factor) applies contrast: pixel = mid + (pixel-mid)*factor. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for negative factor. PBM returns clone. factor=1 is identity; factor=0 maps to midpoint.
FodsDocument.MimeType returns office:document/@office:mimetype (spreadsheet MIME). OdfVersion returns office:document/@office:version. Both non-null for CreateNew(). Both are idempotent.
FodtDocument.GetHeadingTexts() returns text of all heading paragraphs in document order. Returns empty list if no headings. Paragraphs excluded.
